setup.lead: Workspace Docs is not wired to a live editor URL yet. Deploy the workspace-docs service, then point Multica web at it.
setup.step_deploy: Build and run wuzihuang/workspace-docs (Docker image or npm run build && npm start).
setup.step_env: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_WORKSPACE_DOCS_URL to that service’s public URL (or a reverse-proxied path).
setup.step_rebuild: Rebuild/redeploy multica-web so the env is baked into the client bundle.
setup.local_hint: Local dev: npm run dev in workspace-docs → http://localhost:5177, then NEXT_PUBLIC_WORKSPACE_DOCS_URL=http://localhost:5177.
